function: Learned channel acquisition for massive MIMO-OFDM: fuses past channels with a small pilot-based partial estimate of the present channel (RCDNet, ACDNet), joint estimation and prediction (pp. 4-5).
system: BS with 32-antenna ULA (8x4 UPA in appendix) serving single-antenna users; OFDM with 32 subcarriers; 3.5 GHz, 40 MHz; no RIS (p. 9, Table II; p. 14).
method: Complex-domain MLP-mixer (CMixer) modules plus LSTM (RCDNet) or transformer encoder (ACDNet) for past-present interaction; supervised offline training with MSE loss and data augmentation (pp. 6-9).
data_channel: DeepMIMO ray-tracing O1 scenario, BS 3, 3.5 GHz, 25 paths; 3000 training and 20000 mobile plus 20000 quasi-static test sequences, from different areas (p. 9, Table II).
test_conditions: Different areas of the O1 scenario for training and testing (same BS, band, ULA); test split into mobile and quasi-static; pilots, past channels, CSI noise swept (pp. 9-12).
baselines: Channel estimation enhanced by CMixer-based mapping [17] and LSTM-based channel prediction [23]; both are learned, no classical LS, MMSE or interpolation baseline (p. 10).
metrics: NMSE and cosine correlation rho between acquired and true channel; NMSE CDF; FLOPs; GPU memory (pp. 10-11, Tables III-IV).
complexity: Big-O RCDNet O(S^2*n+Nc*Nt^2+Nt*Nc^2+Nt*Nc*S*n) (p. 8); FLOPs 194.89 M RCDNet, 373.51 M ACDNet (Table III, p. 9).
openness: none released by the authors; uses the public DeepMIMO dataset [36] (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 9: "we use open-source raytracing-based DeepMIMO scenarios and datasets [36] for experiments"; training and testing both use the DeepMIMO 'O1' scenario (Table II).
q2_support: p. 9: "We collect the training and test data in different areas of the scenario to avoid data leakage"; this is a spatial hold-out inside the same O1 scenario, BS, band and array. No test on another scenario, band or array of a model trained on one is stated.
q3_support: p. 10: "the channel prediction based on an LSTM network [23]" and "the channel estimation enhanced by CMixer-based channel mapping" are the only two benchmarks, both learned; no non-learned method (LS, MMSE, interpolation) is compared.
q4_support: p. 8: "the computational complexity of RCDNet is O(S" followed by the full order expression; p. 10: "the floating operation points (FLOPs) of all schemes" are reported in Table III (p. 9).
q5_support: p. 9: "we use open-source raytracing-based DeepMIMO scenarios and datasets [36] for experiments"; the training and test channels come from this public ray-tracing dataset. The authors release no code of their own.
notes: Area 2: joint channel estimation and prediction (channel deduction). q1 and q5 rest on the public DeepMIMO ray-tracing dataset (O1 scenario, 3.5 GHz). q3 is 0 because both benchmarks (CMixer-based estimation, LSTM-based prediction) are learned and no non-learned baseline appears in Figs. 8-14 or Tables IV-V. q2 is 0: the training and test areas differ only inside one scenario, the robustness tests sweep the CSI error, and the UPA appendix (p. 14) does not state transfer from the ULA model; reviewer should confirm the spatial hold-out is not counted.
